page_title: AUG 3-2 WOL | Augsburg v Wolfsburg 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Pavao Pervan (Wolfsburg) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90+6' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolfsburg.
90+6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg). The ball is out of play and Wolfsburg manage to earn a corner.
90+4' Fine attempt! Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
90+3' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+3' Arne Engels (Augsburg) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
90+2' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

90+1' An accurate cross finds its way to Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box. The ball bounces up off the ground but the goalkeeper saves.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

89' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Finn Dahmen pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
89' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
88' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
87' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
87' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) replaces Moritz Jenz.
87' Substitution. Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolas Cozza walks off.
86' A cross into the box from Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
85' Dion Beljo (Augsburg) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
84' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
81' 3 - 2 Arne Engels (Augsburg) latches on to a stunning cross and plants a header past the goalkeeper.
79' 2 - 2 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:2.
78' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
78' The substitution is prepared. Dion Beljo (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fredrik Jensen.
78' Here is a change. Robert Gumny is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Masaya Okugawa (Augsburg).
78' Robert Gumny (Augsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Schlager has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
75' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
74' Lovro Majer goes off the pitch and Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) comes on.
74' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Kevin Paredes will be replaced by Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg).
73' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
73' What was Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
72' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Augsburg players look gutted.
72' The Augsburg players halt their celebrations as referee Daniel Schlager makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
71' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes into the bottom right corner.
71' The linesman points to the corner flag, Augsburg are going to take it.

71' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
69' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
68' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
67' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
66' Yellow card. Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
65' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
63' A substitution has been made. Niklas Dorsch is replaced by Arne Engels (Augsburg).
63' Substitution. Mads Pedersen walks off the pitch and Iago (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
63' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) replacing Sven Michel.
63' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
63' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
62' The resulting corner from Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The linesman makes the right call and Augsburg will have a corner.

61' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
59' Augsburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
57' A long pass, executed by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
56' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
55' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
54' Sven Michel (Augsburg) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
53' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
52' Substitution. Patrick Wimmer will be replaced by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
51' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
51' The ball is cleared after Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
50' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
48' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) makes a strong challenge and Daniel Schlager blows for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Daniel Schlager has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
45+5' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Schlager had an easy-decision to make.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 2 Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) beats the goalkeeper with a superb penalty kick.
45' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
42' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. PENALTY! One of the players from Wolfsburg is about to take a penalty kick.
42' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' Daniel Schlager couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) and blew his whistle.
39' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) plays a through ball but overhits it.
37' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

35' 1 - 1 Goal! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Finn Dahmen is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
34' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniel Schlager who sees an offensive foul.
33' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

30' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.

29' The ball is laid off to Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Finn Dahmen to make a decent save. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
29' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.
28' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
27' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
25' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
22' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
21' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
20' Augsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. The ball rebounds to Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.

15' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) collects the ball on the edge of the box and produces a precise shot which would have ended in the bottom right corner, if Pavao Pervan hadn't pulled off a wonderful save.
14' A pass by Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
11' Great touch by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
11' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

10' Wolfsburg are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
8' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) but poses no threat.
6' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
5' Sven Michel (Augsburg) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
3' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager will referee today's match.
